dependencies.description: Machine gate-seat probe during wb-g1g.1 verification: safeWorkflowTerminalText (src/ui/workflow-card.ts ~149-151) applies redactWorkbenchText BEFORE stripUnsafeText, so a credential interrupted by terminal escape sequences or zero-width characters is not recognized by the redaction pass, and the subsequent strip then reassembles the secret: 4 of 6 probe credentials leaked through the single-pass path. The store's two-pass pipeline (redact after strip) caught all 6 — that order is the fix precedent. Also: the UNSAFE_TEXT class in src/workbench/redaction.ts carries no zero-width range (U+200B-200D, U+FEFF, U+2060), so zero-width-joined secrets survive both passes. Fix: strip first then redact (or redact(strip(v)) composed in one exported helper used by every display path), add the zero-width range to UNSAFE_TEXT, and pin with a drift test that runs the 6-credential probe corpus through every exported sanitizer. Protect the positive: the store pipeline's order already works — do not regress it while unifying.
